movie.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe
movie.originalTitle: 機動戦士ガンダム  閃光のハサウェイ キルケーの魔女
movie.overview: Haunted by past trauma, Hathaway Noa is drawn to a mysterious girl named Gigi Andalucia, whose strange powers stir memories within him. While swayed by her cryptic words, he continues preparing for Mafty's mission -- the attack on the Adelaide Conference. Meanwhile, Kenneth Sleg of the Earth Federation Forces prepares a defense operation for the Adelaide Conference and a plan to eliminate Mafty and is approached by Handley Yoxon of the Criminal Police Organization with a secret proposal. As Hathaway and Kenneth pursue their respective goals, Gigi also sets off for Hong Kong to fulfill her own role.

reviews.author: Chris Sawin
reviews.content:
Mobile Suit Gundam: Hathaway has some hiccups, but ultimately shows promise with its action sequences. But Mobile Suit Gundam: The Sorcery of Nymph Circe is so dull, feels tortuously long, and all of the characters are selfish a-holes. The sequel feels uneventful, and its strange use of almost absolute darkness and bizarre montages only sours the fact that you could be watching mobile suits pound each other stupid in the sky instead.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Haunted by his past and drawn to the mysterious Gigi Andalucia, Hathaway Noa prepares Mafty's strike on the Adelaide Conference while Federation officer Kenneth Sleg maneuvers to dismantle the insurgent threat.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Hathaway Noa continues to lead the anti-Federation terrorist group Mafty as they plan a decisive strike against the high-level Adelaide Conference on Earth. Along the way, he finds himself deeply unsettled by Gigi Andalucia, a young woman whose strange, perceptive nature echoes traumatic ghosts of his past. Meanwhile, Federation Commander Kenneth Sleg fortifies Earth's defenses and forms key political alliances to hunt down Mafty once and for all. As all factions converge toward Hong Kong and Adelaide, their personal fates and ideological battles grow dangerously intertwined.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Following the events of Mafty's initial insurgent operations, Hathaway Noa remains tormented by memories of Quess Paraya and his traumatic experiences during the Second Neo Zeon War. His secret life as the revolutionary leader of Mafty becomes further complicated when he encounters Gigi Andalucia, a captivating young woman whose eerie intuition and enigmatic comments unnerve him. Despite these emotional distractions, Hathaway stays focused on coordinating Mafty's next major target: the Earth Federation's Adelaide Conference, where corrupt officials plan to pass oppressive environmental legislation. On the opposing side, Federation Commander Kenneth Sleg actively mobilizes his defense forces and devises a strategic trap to neutralize Mafty before the conference takes place. Kenneth is approached by Handley Yoxon of the Criminal Police Organization, who offers a covert partnership that could tip the operational balance in the Federation's favor. Sensing the growing net around his organization, Hathaway must carefully balance his personal inner turmoil with the ruthless demands of leading a rebellion. Gigi eventually departs for Hong Kong to fulfill her own obscure motives, placing her squarely between the opposing commanders. As both sides complete their military preparations, the stage is set for a high-stakes clash that will shape the future of the Earth and the Universal Century.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Haunted by the shadows of his past, Hathaway Noa continues to lead Mafty, an anti-Federation insurgent organization dedicated to exposing and dismantling the Earth Federation's corrupt regime. As Mafty prepares for a high-stakes assault on the upcoming Adelaide Conference, Hathaway finds his resolve tested by Gigi Andalucia, an enigmatic young woman whose unusual perception stirs deep memories within him. Simultaneously, Earth Federation Commander Kenneth Sleg fortifies his forces for the conference's defense, coordinating with local intelligence to systematically eliminate the revolutionary threat. As political tensions mount and military forces maneuver, Hathaway, Kenneth, and Gigi each set out on paths that inevitably collide in Hong Kong, setting the stage for a dramatic conflict over the fate of humanity.

faq.answer: Yes, it is part of the long-running Universal Century timeline of the Mobile Suit Gundam franchise. Specifically, it serves as the second entry in the Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway film trilogy, following the 2021 movie Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway.
faq.question: Is this movie part of a franchise?

faq.answer: The dominant genres are Mecha, Science Fiction, Military Action, and Psychological Drama.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe?

faq.answer: Yes, there is a mid/post-credits teaser scene that hints at the upcoming third and final installment of the Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway movie trilogy.
faq.question: Is there a post-credit scene in the movie?

faq.answer: Yes, it is highly recommended to watch at least Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack and the first Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway film, as the plot directly builds upon the characters, lore, and unresolved conflicts established in those entries.
faq.question: Do I need to watch previous Gundam titles before watching this film?

faq.answer: It is based on the novel series Mobile Suit Gundam: Hathaway's Flash, written by original Gundam creator Yoshiyuki Tomino.
faq.question: What source material is this movie based on?

faq.answer: The main protagonist is Hathaway Noa, who operates under the alias Mafty Navue Erin as the leader of the anti-Earth Federation insurgent group Mafty.
faq.question: Who is the main protagonist in this film?

faq.answer: The film was produced and animated by Sunrise (Bandai Namco Filmworks), directed by Shukou Murase.
faq.question: Who animated and produced MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM HATHAWAY The Sorcery of Nymph Circe?

faq.answer: The Adelaide Conference is a high-level meeting of Earth Federation officials where a controversial law enforcing forced deportation of civilians from Earth is scheduled to be finalized, making it Mafty's primary military target.
faq.question: What is the significance of the Adelaide Conference in the story?

faq.answer: Kenneth Sleg is a high-ranking officer in the Earth Federation Forces and the commander tasked with establishing defenses around the Adelaide Conference and neutralizing Mafty.
faq.question: Who is Kenneth Sleg and what is his role in the narrative?

faq.answer: While newcomers can enjoy its high-quality animation and action, the complex political drama and dense Universal Century continuity make it far more enjoyable for viewers familiar with the Gundam franchise.
faq.question: Is this film suitable for newcomers to anime?
